app.title: Minecraft Setup Manager
app.subtitle: Gets Minecraft ready for the server.

official.label: Minecraft Launcher
official.detail: Best choice if you use the normal Minecraft app.

sklauncher.label: SKlauncher
sklauncher.detail: Use this if you play through SKlauncher.

manual.label: Manual setup
manual.detail: Use this if your launcher is different.

lowEnd.label: Low power
lowEnd.detail: For older laptops or weak graphics.

shaders.label: Shaders
shaders.detail: For stronger PCs that can handle nicer lighting.

server.title: Choose a server.
server.lead: Enter the server address. The app gets the setup list from that server and shows what it wants to add or update.
server.help: Use the address players type in Minecraft. The app looks for the setup list from there.
server.emptySaved: Saved servers will appear here after you add one.

launcher.title: Choose your launcher.
launcher.lead: Pick the app you use to open Minecraft. If we cannot find it, manual setup is still available.

profile.title: Choose how Minecraft should run.
profile.lead: Pick the option that matches your computer. The setup file saves the right mod list either way.

install.title: Review the setup steps.
install.lead: This checks Fabric, creates the clean game folder, and adds a launcher profile.
install.emptyLog: [waiting] Ready to create the local setup.

verify_loader.label: Check Minecraft version
verify_loader.detail: Make sure the right loader is available.

install_loader.label: Install Fabric
install_loader.detail: Add Fabric if this server needs it.

ensure_launcher_profile.label: Add the launcher profile
ensure_launcher_profile.detail: Create or update {{subject}} in your launcher.

write_setup_receipt.label: Save the setup record
write_setup_receipt.detail: Remember this setup so updates can be checked later.

validate_setup.label: Check everything
validate_setup.detail: Check the local files and launcher profile.

diagnostics.title: Check the setup.
diagnostics.lead: These checks look at the local setup files.

manifest.label: Setup list loaded
manifest.detail: Minecraft, Fabric, server, and mod choices are ready.

done.title: Local setup is ready.
done.lead: The clean game folder and setup file are ready on this computer.
